simple.meaning: זְאֵב (zᵉʼêb) is a Hebrew word meaning “a wolf.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זְאֵב (H2061) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 49:27, with occurrences in Genesis, Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Habakkuk, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זְאֵב (H2061) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in זְאֵב (H2061) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: זְאֵב (zᵉʼêb) / H2061 is traced through Genesis 49:27, Isaiah 11:6, Isaiah 65:25, Jeremiah 5:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

majorEvents.label: Blood witness
majorEvents.evidenceText: Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

timeline.evidenceText: The wolf will live with the lamb,
The wolf and the lamb will feed together.

Therefore a lion out of the forest will kill them. A wolf of the evenings will destroy them. A leopard will watch against their cities. Everyone who goes out there will be torn in pieces, because their transgressions are many and their backsliding has increased.
Her princes within it are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, that they may get dishonest gain.

Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
Her princes within her are roaring lions. Her judges are evening wolves. They leave nothing until the next day.

structuredEvidence.canonicalTrailSummary: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 49:27 and continues through Zephaniah 3:3.

definitions.full: H2061. zeeb I. זְאֵב noun masculine Isa 11:6 wolf (Late Hebrew id. , Arabic ( jackal according to Hom NS 303 ff. ; but see RS ZMG 1880, 373 and Doughty Arab. Deseria i. 327 ; ii. 144, 145) Aramaic דֵּיבָה , Assyrian zîbu Dl S 47 ; Ethiopic hyena Di 1056 (on formation compare Lag BN 58 ); Phoenician in compound proper name זיבקם ) — זְאֵב absolute Gen 49:27 2 t.; construct Jer 5:6 ; plural זְאֵבִים Ezek 22:27 ; construct זְאֵבֵי Hab 1:8 ; Zeph 3:3 ; — wolf , never in narrative; in predictions of peace in Messian. age כֶּבֶשׂ עִם זְאֵב וְגָר Isa 11:6 כְּאֶחָד יִרְעוּ וְטָלֶה זְאֵב 65:25 ; in simile, of Benjamin's fierceness ׳ב יִטְרָ֑ף זְאֵב Gen 49:27 ; of fierce horses of Chaldeans עֶרֶב מִזְּאֵבֵי חַדּוּ Hab 1:8 (|| מִנְּמֵרִים קַלּוּ ); of princes of Judah טָ֑רֶף טֹרְפֵי כִּזְאֵבִים Ezek 22:27 ; metaphor of enemies of Judah Jer 5:6 עֲרָבוֺת זְאֵב (|| נָמֵר אַרְיֵה, ); of corrupt and oppressive judges עֶרֶב זְאֵבֵי שֹׁפְטֶיהָ Zeph 3:3 (|| שֹׁאֲגִים אֲרָיוֺת ).
